descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-18 Billing Suggestion · S23 Billing card, retry state and the custom-template form pass axe (WCAG 2 A/AA)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U6 A code is always shown, with the elements (Problem, Data, Risk) and the quotes from the note underneath, presented as a suggestion for the physician to verify. … (UAT TC-18; TFA-92596 AC 6) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr
  • U8 Creating a custom template requires a note-type selection (one of the 8 pilot templates or 'Procedure / other'); the template cannot be saved without one (step 3). (UAT TC-18; TFA-92599 AC 8; TFA-92599 How it works 6) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress
  • U15 If the billing call fails, the call is retried automatically, the note is still shown and the billing area shows a clear error with a way to retry; … (UAT Empty & Failure States (Billing suggestion failed); UAT 3.5; TFA-94745 AC 4)

Test design technique: Accessibility (accessibility) — Check screen-reader, keyboard, contrast and tap-size rules (axe): users with disabilities have to be able to use it too.

Given Post-Round with a stored billing suggestion (Hospital and Nursing Home), the error / retry state, and the Create Note Template form; the discharge time prompt once built

When Visual lane runs axe on each state

Then No WCAG 2 A/AA violations; the retry and time-choice controls are buttons with accessible names; the card is announced politely

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): axe-core violations = 0 (visual-checks.ts); accessible names present for the retry and time-choice buttons

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); lane planned in the matrix: visual / mobile (blocked)

S23 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-18.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 43c38a4f (10-15 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); secondary: FAULT · Fault injection — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-18 Billing Suggestion · Section: A4 · Post-Round · Scenario: TC-18/S23

Billing card, retry state and the custom-template form pass axe (WCAG 2 A/AA)

Tickets: TFA-92596 Billing Suggestion (ready for qa); TFA-92599 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch (in progress); TFA-94745 Empty & Failure States (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-c: status record-only in newspec-c/results.json → passed (record only (every judged cell passed, the rest is recorded only)).

Detail:

Our own addition (no UAT item or ticket asks for WCAG): recorded. axe on the card: result card (Hospital and Nursing Home) 1 serious color-contrast violation each, the grey '(none)' text under an empty element (text-slate-400; same pattern as A4); error / retry state 0; discharge prompt 0; Create Note Template form 0 (both contexts). The retry control is a named button, the two time choices are buttons '≤ 30 min' / '> 30 min' in a group 'Time on discharge', the Note Type field is labelled and required, every card state is an aria-live=polite region.

Evidence: 4 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane V: visual-lane.ts reads a make-session.ts fixture (a fresh local account made with the admin key), and make-session.ts refuses dev; the error state also needs a mocked ai/notes:suggestBilling.. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).

This case has results elsewhere too (a case shows one result: a verdict beats blocked, a run beats a skip; within a tier the worse one, on a tie the earlier one (dev, dev lanes, local lane A/C, new local lanes), test out of date ranks above passed; when all are skips the dev one, unless dev only says "local only / can't run on dev" or gives the lane's own reason):

  • [local visual] passed (visual/results.json) — visual: passed → passed (passed) desktop, iphone15, pixel7: 27 judged check(s) passed, 0 failed. Billing card (both contexts), retry state and Create Note Template form: axe 0, the retry is a named button, the card is aria-live=polite.
